About This Saree

A Muslin handwoven in the traditional technique, where each motif is woven separately into the fabric — never stitched on. The festive palette is hand-dyed, with intricate zari work across the pallu and border. Sourced directly from a fourth-generation weaving family in Bengal.

Air-light mull cotton
Handspun muslin weave
